Under her leadership, Soda gained piped water, its first bank branch where many women opened their first bank accounts, and a girls’ college that was saved from closure. Her work transformed the village into a national model of rural governance. A graduate in English Literature from Lady Shri Ram College, Chhavi is an Aspen Fellow and a World Economic Forum Young Global Leader. She has spoken at the United Nations, the Harvard India Conference, TEDx, and leadership forums across India. Thoughtful and ever-evolving, Urvi continues to expand her creative and academic pursuits, striving to make literature—and meaningful conversations—accessible to all. b: Architect. Vandana Sehgal is an architect, academic, artist and curator based in Lucknow. Since 2017, she has been Principal and Dean of the Faculty of Architecture and Planning at Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical…
f: Architect. Vandana Sehgal is an architect, academic, artist and curator based in Lucknow. Since 2017, she has been Principal and Dean of the Faculty of Architecture and Planning at Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow. She holds a PhD in Architecture from the School of Planning and Architecture, New Delhi, where her doctoral research explored the idea of the infinite in architecture. Over many years in architectural education, she has shaped curricula, academic structures and institutional leadership. She has guided faculty and doctoral scholars and built a culture of research and inquiry. Her interests span architectural design, theory and interdisciplinary studies. She believes in an education where theory informs design and practical exposure deepens learning, and she encourages critical thinking, creativity and sensitivity to context in her students. Alongside her academic work, she has sustained a long practice in art. As a painter, she has held solo exhibitions including Between Spaces (2006) and Krishna and Woman (2015). Her Ramayana series travelled to New Delhi, Kolkata, Chandigarh, Mumbai and Lucknow between 2010 and 2013. She has also created painted illustrations for books from Rupa Publications, among them Ram Varma’s Ramayana: The Story of Ram Before He Was God. Her work dwells on the spaces in between: the sacred and the profane, the clamour and the silence, the light and the dark. As a curator, she has conceived more than 25 exhibitions. She began at the Saraca Art Gallery, Hotel Lebua, and now curates at Kokoro Art Gallery, Lucknow, which she founded. Named after the Japanese idea of heart, mind and spirit, Kokoro has become a platform for contemporary artistic voices and cultural dialogue. Bridging education, design, research and art, Dr Sehgal continues to widen the conversation around architecture and to influence the next generation of architects and designers. f: Founder, Sofranama; Culinary Heritage Custodian. Zeenat Abbasi (Suhail), founder of Sofranama, is a custodian of Awadhi culinary heritage, preserving heirloom recipes passed down through generations of her maternal (Ahmad) and paternal (Abbasid) lineages. She inherited these culinary traditions from her mother, mother-in-law, and the khansamas who once cooked for the Nawabs.
